limitations: Author inspection is not independent approval. Parent review and external exact root release remain required.
No candidate source imported, runtime binary/interpreter inspected, numerical test performed, array loaded, remote path accessed, staging or launch.

Cleanup deadline bounds repeated observation and waits; uninterruptible kernel/filesystem calls and durable storage failure cannot be guaranteed away.
Closure means the held leader exit is observed and no live members of its observed original session/group remain; zombies can remain for external reaping after supervisor exit.
Unresolved cleanup records non-adoption; supervisor exit relinquishes ownership without implicit parent Popen reap.
Default dtype, actual CUDA version and complete autocast state remain outside the unchanged original numerical guards.
Count digests and histograms are receipt consistency checks, not an independent numerical recomputation.
Per-seed incomplete histograms remain in memory until that seed completes, as in v1.
